summary: Updates the Sieve reject extension from RFC 3028 so a message can be refused during delivery instead of by sending a bounce. This helps avoid contributing to floods of bounces after forged-sender spam. This is a Proposed Standard that obsoletes RFC 3028 and updates RFC 5228.

eli5.summary: If a stranger sends junk and puts your name on it, sending a note back to you just adds to your mess. This lets the mail system say no right at the door.

questions: how to reject mail without sending bounce messages
